title: Aurora black triangle program

tellings.quote: The Aurora had also showed up as a line item in the 1987 congressional budget with $2.3 billion earmarked for it, something Lockheed had trouble explaining away.

plain: A secret aircraft programme called Aurora, tied to black triangle shaped craft seen over the North Sea and to Groom Lake, a secret test site in Nevada, appeared as a line item in the 1987 US congressional budget with $2.3 billion set aside for it, something the aircraft maker Lockheed "had trouble explaining away." Michels tells this himself, drawing on the aviation writer Nick Cook and crediting the 1987 budget, the defence magazine Jane's Defence Weekly and British Ministry of Defence documents, which would point to a hidden, well-funded aircraft programme.
